description:
Custom Windows Forms Controls.
      
      The library includes various controls, such as:
      - AnsiColoringRichTextBox
      - EditableComboBox
      - FileBrowserView
      - Kbd300ASimulator
      - MovablePanel
      - MovableSizablePanel
      - MtfListView
      - MtfPictureBox
      - MtfTreeView
      - PasswordBox
      - RichTextBoxWithLineNumbers
      - RotatableImagePanel
      - SourceCodeViewerRichTextBox
      - TextBoxWithRegEx
      - TransparentPanel
      
      Compatibility:
      - .NET Framework 4.5.2
      - .NET Framework 4.8
      - .NET Framework 4.8.1
      - .NET 8
      - .NET 9
